items.title: Protect your Launchpad API tokens with a security key
items.text: Supply-chain attacks that harvest developer credentials are on the rise. The Shai-Hulud campaign, for example, used automated scanners to sweep up any secrets they could find in files and keyrings. If you use Launchpad’s API, one of those secrets is your API token – and until now it has been about as safe as the laptop it sits on.
